description: Source code implementing block layout classes and methods for HLSL shader translation in the ANGLE project, including functions for calculating register layout and offset management.

classes.name: HLSLBlockEncoder
classes.description: Class responsible for encoding block layout for HLSL shaders, managing register alignment, offset calculation, and layout strategy based on shader output type.

methods.name: HLSLBlockEncoder::enterAggregateType
methods.description: Handles entering a struct or aggregate shader variable, aligning to register boundary.

methods.name: HLSLBlockEncoder::exitAggregateType
methods.description: Handles exiting a struct or aggregate shader variable.

methods.name: HLSLBlockEncoder::getBlockLayoutInfo
methods.description: Calculates array and matrix stride information for a given variable type, considering packing and matrix orientation.

methods.name: HLSLBlockEncoder::advanceOffset
methods.description: Advances the current offset based on variable type, array size, and matrix properties.

methods.name: HLSLBlockEncoder::skipRegisters
methods.description: Skips a specified number of registers by advancing the offset.

methods.name: HLSLBlockEncoder::GetStrategyFor
methods.description: Determines encoding strategy based on shader output type.

methods.name: HLSLVariableRegisterCount
methods.description: Recursively counts the number of registers needed for a shader variable, handling structs and arrays.

methods.name: HLSLVariableRegisterCount (overload)
methods.description: Calculates total register count for a shader variable based on accumulated offset and register size.
